findings.evidence: ## Voice and tone: 'High-arousal framing (surprise, urgency, a hot take) is optional even for promotional posts. For grief, reflection, apology or factual updates keep the author's emotion, favour sincerity and clarity, and never add anger, FOMO or controversy.'
findings.fix: Delete the Voice and tone section. Step 3's sensitive-post branch (line 18), step 2's clarity objective (line 17) and the ragebait NEVER item (line 41) already cover this, and the model already knows to avoid outrage in a grief post.

findings.evidence: Step 3 packs the three levers, the shorten-only branch, 'A discussion prompt wins when the author wants feedback or community; a standalone statement wins for reach beyond followers.' and the sensitive-post replacement into one paragraph
findings.fix: Split step 3 into sub-bullets: 3a the three levers, 3b the shorten-only case, 3c the sensitive-post quiet variants. Delete the 'discussion prompt wins / standalone statement wins' sentence, because steps 2 and 5 already choose the winner from the objective, and two selection rules can disagree.

findings.evidence: The Gotchas section has only two items ('Compression can falsify...', 'Unicode bold/italic "fancy text" costs 2 per glyph...')
findings.fix: Add thread-specific gotchas learned from failures. For example: 'In a thread, never split a number from its baseline or qualifier across posts, because readers see post 1 alone in the timeline and post 1 must stand without post 2.'

findings.evidence: '4c. Within 15 of the limit: trim further, or tell the user to confirm the count in X's composer.'
findings.fix: Give a default with an escape hatch: 'Within 15 of the limit: trim to 265 or fewer. Only if trimming would drop a supplied fact or qualifier, keep the text and add "confirm the count in X's composer" under BEFORE POSTING.'

findings.evidence: Line 53 says that in the three-thread case 'each VERSION block holds its thread', and line 57 adds 'THREAD (only when chosen or offered)'. In that case a thread is offered, so it is unclear whether THREAD repeats a thread. Line 24 'plus any hybrid' has no defined format.
findings.fix: State: 'In the three-thread case omit THREAD; RECOMMENDED names the chosen VERSION's thread. Use THREAD only when a single-post run turns into a thread.' Also define the hybrid as one extra draft with its count under RECOMMENDED, or drop 'plus any hybrid'.
